claim_ceiling: Citation heritage benchmark infrastructure validated on frozen 174k pair pool; dense partial embeddings (2000-2015) evaluated — all PASS AUC (~0.90-0.91) but FAIL recall@10 (~0.0), consistent with TF-IDF 174k pattern. Center-projection does not improve citation neighborhood recovery. Lane remains BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES pending full 174k dense embeddings.
evidence_summary: Four dense partial representations evaluated on 99,325 decisions (2000-2015) with 13,648 positive / 45,070 negative frozen citation pairs. All PASS AUC (>0.65): multilingual_e5_768dim=0.9105, center_projected_768dim=0.9047, center_projected_128dim=0.9053, center_projected_64dim=0.9057. All FAIL recall@10 (>0.2): 0.014, 0.000, 0.000, 0.000. Exact k-NN used (sklearn_exact), no HNSW artifact. Results consistent with TF-IDF 174k baseline (8 reps, all FAIL recall@10). State files and cycle report updated consistently. Negative/null results honestly reported. Lane correctly BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES.
